headlines.title: DOJ issues subpoenas in Alaska Senate race as governor launches separate investigation
headlines.description: Republican Gov. Mike Dunleavy said he was directing the state’s Department of Public Safety to determine “whether criminal charges or civil action are warranted.”

headlines.title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s attack ad against Amy Acton’s ends TV run
headlines.description: Republican Vivek Ramaswamy’s ad featuring the estranged mother of Amy Acton, his Democratic opponent for Ohio governor, is leaving the state’s airwaves, the Ramaswamy campaign confirmed Thursday.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Iconic actor Patrick Stewart, known for ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men,’ dies at age 86
headlines.description: Sci-fi star Patrick Stewart has died, according to a spokesperson, after "a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia." Stewart is known for playing Professor X in the “X-Men” film series and Capt. Jean-Luc Picard in the “Star Trek” franchise. NBC News' Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Neither Israeli party is expected to win an outright majority in the elections
headlines.description: Neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his challenger Gadi Eisenkot is projected to win an outright parliamentary majority with more than 90% of the vote counted. NBC News’ Matt Bradley breaks down the election results and what they could mean for Israel’s political future.

headlines.title: Death Toll Rises in High-Speed Train Crash in Spain
headlines.description: A massive recovery operation is underway in Spain with anger growing among the public after a violent high-speed train collision. Crews are searching for any additional victims as the death toll rises. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lawyers fighting N.Y. AG’s role in Cornell assault investigation say she isn’t ‘viable’ as prosecutor
headlines.description: Gillio Lopes, who has denied sexually assaulting Jane Doe, filed a petition seeking to block Letitia James’ appointment to oversee the case.

headlines.title: The former youth pastor leading one of the NFL’s best offenses
headlines.description: Nate Scheelhaase, the Los Angeles Rams’ offensive coordinator, is a former youth pastor. He credits time in the church for his success in professional football.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Fears of Binance hack prompt Tether, Circle to freeze over $1.5 billion in funds
headlines.description: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is investigating a potential hack after a series of very large transfers on the platform caught the attention of traders.
